item.text: {"role":"structure","inspection_scope":"Complete data-only review of the film structure, all four beat contracts, rhetorical progression, setup boundaries, semantic centers, planned hierarchy, state changes, and persistence.","checks":[{"check":"METAPHOR_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"Setup s1 uses one coherent inspection rule: the same document enters a lens, reveals broken routes, receives aligned patches, and exits. Repair remains causally attached to the findings rather than introducing a separate explanatory world."},{"check":"STATE_ACCUMULATION_WITHOUT_MEANING","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Every beat retains receipts in the depth planes and specifies “Receipt settling carries into next beat,” although receipts never express inspection, revealed marks, route repair, or release. This obsolete residual mechanism persists as each new page state arrives."},{"check":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The page/lens/Bot inspection group is joined by an unrelated receipt/pricing group. All beats name “receipt pile” as the focal target and include “pricing placards” and “receipts and Bot” in the set, creating a second dominant semantic group unsupported by the argument."},{"check":"COMPOSITIONAL_STAGNATION","status":"PASS","evidence":"All four beats retain the same central page-and-lens composition and subject framing, but the propositions are causally related stages of one continuous inspection rule. The page meaningfully changes from waiting to exposed, patched, and released."},{"check":"CONTINUITY_TOKEN_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"The same page has a clear lifecycle and destination: slot, lens, revealed marks, repaired routes, then intact exit. No additional continuity tokens are declared, and the page’s persistence is meaningful."},{"check":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Tile wall, pricing placards, receipt pile, receipts, and repeated receipt settling have no stated story, location, action, or balance function for document inspection. The plan instead explicitly directs focus toward the unrelated receipt pile."},{"check":"WEAK_RESET_RHYTHM","status":"PASS","evidence":"No semantic reset is required inside s1 because inspection, revelation, repair, and release evolve one document under one causal rule. The end reset is appropriate when the page exits and the argument concludes."},{"check":"COMPETING_FOCI","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Each beat’s dominant action concerns the inspected document, lens, marks, patches, or exit, while each beat independently declares “receipt pile” as its focal target. The planned hierarchy therefore points attention away from the primary action."},{"check":"CAPTION_CARRIES_STORY","status":"PASS","evidence":"The shot contracts specify visible central actions and before/after changes: the page reaches the lens, concealed marks become visible, interrupted routes reconnect under patches, and the intact page exits. The meaning does not depend on narration alone."}],"setup_assessments":[{"setup_id":"s1","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The setup boundary and page-inspection progression are coherent, but all four beat contracts retain an unrelated receipt/pricing mechanism and designate the receipt pile—not the inspected page—as the focal target. This produces purposeless accumulation, semantic competition, clutter, and conflicting hierarchy within s1."}],"violations":[{"code":"STATE_ACCUMULATION_WITHOUT_MEANING","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"Receipt geometry and “Receipt settling carries into next beat” persist through b1–b4 without changing or communicating any current page-inspection state.","smallest_structural_correction":"Remove the receipt carryover from all beats and let residual motion belong to the inspected page, lens, revealed marks, or newly placed patches."},{"code":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"The document/lens/patch inspection group competes with an unrelated receipt pile, pricing placards, and receipt-oriented depth layer.","smallest_structural_correction":"Delete the receipt-and-pricing group from s1, retaining only environmental cues that locate or support the document inspection."},{"code":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"Pricing placards, receipts, and receipt settling have no documented function in story, location, action, or balance and conflict with the stated paper backboard/work-surface environment.","smallest_structural_correction":"Simplify the set contract to the page, inspection lens or slot, Bot, work surface, and only the minimum inspection-related location cues."},{"code":"COMPETING_FOCI","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"All four beats identify “receipt pile” as the focal target even though their primary actions and before/after states occur on the inspected document.","smallest_structural_correction":"Change each beat’s focal target to the active page detail: the feed contact in b1, exposed marks in b2, patch-to-route contact in b3, and intact exiting page in b4."}],"limits":"This data-only review evaluates planned structure and hierarchy. It cannot establish rendered clarity, actual pixel visibility, motion execution, caption legibility, audio performance, or whether the primary action will command a real mobile glance at 360×640."}
